content.text: /ext:medcp In children 5-17 with asthma, do monthly ED visits for exacerbation and oral steroid bursts show fall and spring peaks over the last three years?
I'll query the MedCP clinical database for pediatric asthma visit patterns. Let me start by checking available tables and then pulling monthly ED visit and oral steroid data for children 5-17.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE (vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM' AND concept_name LIKE 'Asthma%')
   OR (concept_class_id = 'Clinical Finding' AND standard_concept = 'S' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%asthma%')
ORDER BY concept_id;

-- Look up systemic oral corticosteroids (prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone)
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, dr.drug_concept_id, dc.concept_name as drug_name
FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
JOIN omop.concept a ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = a.concept_id
LEFT JOIN omop.drug_strength ds ON ds.candidate_component_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
LEFT JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE a.concept_id IN (432879)  -- Prednisone or systemic corticosteroid class
   OR LOWER(a.concept_name) LIKE 'corticosteroid%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, dr.drug_concept_id, dc.concept_name
ORDER BY c.concept_id
LIMIT 50;

arguments.sql_query:
-- Monthly ED visits for childhood asthma (ages 5-17) with primary diagnosis of asthma
-- Using condition_occurrence (asthma = SNOMED 317009 or ICD-10-CM J45.x parent concept)
SELECT 
    FORMAT(v.visit_start_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month_year,
    YEAR(v.visit_start_date) * 100 + MONTH(v.visit_start_date) AS year_month_num,
    COUNT(*) AS ed_visit_count,
    (SELECT DISTINCT p.year_of_birth FROM omop.person p WHERE p.person_id = v.person_id AND DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_datetime, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 5 AND 17) AS pediatric_age_check
FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c ON c.person_id = v.person_id 
    AND c.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
WHERE v.visit_concept_id = 9203 -- ER Visit
    AND c.condition_concept_id IN (317009, 257581) -- Asthma / Acute asthma
    AND v.visit_start_date >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY FORMAT(v.visit_start_date, 'yyyy-MM'), YEAR(v.visit_start_date), MONTH(v.visit_start_date)
ORDER BY year_month_num;
